title: Jonas Brothers to Headline NFL's First Australian Game Halftime Show
text:
The Jonas Brothers will perform at the halftime show of the NFL's inaugural regular-season game in Australia, held at Melbourne Cricket Ground on September 10. The event, featuring the San Francisco 49ers and Los Angeles Rams, will be broadcast live on Netflix. The trio expressed enthusiasm for the opportunity to play for Australian fans and contribute to this historic sports and entertainment celebration.
The Jonas Brothers are set to perform at the halftime show for the NFL's first-ever regular-season game in Australia, taking place on September 10 at Melbourne Cricket Ground.
The trio expressed excitement about playing for passionate Australian fans and being part of this historic moment, which will be broadcast live on Netflix. The performance is part of a collaboration between the NFL, the Victorian State Government, and Visit Victoria. NFL officials highlighted the global appeal of the Jonas Brothers, noting their previous successful NFL appearances, and emphasized the goal of creating a memorable entertainment experience for fans worldwide
